falsification_contract.HYPOTHESIS: expected effect holds: The harvested trickle charge offsets the standing parasitic drain, holding the battery above the no-start threshold so full cranking power remains available after at least one week idle. (recorded prior 0.6, epistemic class MODEL_DERIVED per the killer-experiment provenance)
falsification_contract.TREATMENT: Install a low-wattage PV trickle charger (and/or a small kinetic/vibration harvester) on the vehicle's 12V starter battery, interposed by a charge controller with a voltage sensor and a relay that priority-switches or disconnects non-essential parasitic loads when the battery voltage falls below a threshold, so the battery is replenished and protected during idle periods without manual terminal disconnect.
falsification_contract.CONTROL_BLOCKER: no executed baseline comparison on record (physics chain executed: ['PRE_REQUIREMENTS']; lifecycle MECHANISM_NOT_SIMULATABLE) — the control arm is not invented from the problem statement
falsification_contract.MEASUREMENT: Baseline-test a vehicle battery's resting voltage and cold-cranking amps, then leave the vehicle idle for 7 days with the parasitic load active; repeat with the PV trickle-charge/relay controller fitted and log battery voltage every hour. The mechanism is falsified if the 7-day voltage under the intervention does not stay above ~12.4 V (or fails to deliver rated CCA and a start), or if the relay fails to shed the parasitic load when voltage drops below the set threshold.
falsification_contract.APPARATUS: the falsification test's own recorded instrumentation (stated within MEASUREMENT; not split out — no separate apparatus record exists)
falsification_contract.SAMPLE_BLOCKER: no sample-size / n= record exists in any engine stage (honest UNKNOWN — Art. XXV)
